rules.source_quote: Suspected optic neuritis with any ONE of the following (8):

criteria.description: Clinical suspicion of acute optic neuritis (afferent pupillary defect, visual field loss, pain with eye movement)

required_documentation: Ophthalmology or neurology consultation notes detailing visual acuity, color desaturation, RAPD, or papillitis
rules.review_notes: Urgent optic neuritis evaluation for demyelinating disease (MS/MOG/NMO).
